description: This file contains an abstract base class `TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner` which provides test methods for concurrency scenarios involving transactions with grains in the Orleans framework. It defines methods for testing shared grains, transaction chains, and transaction trees, utilizing grain factories and asynchronous task execution.

classes.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to run concurrency tests involving shared grains, transaction chains, and transaction trees within the Orleans transaction framework.

methods.name: SingleSharedGrainTest
methods.description: Tests concurrent transactions sharing a single grain, verifying that all grains have expected values after concurrent operations.

methods.name: TransactionChainTest
methods.description: Tests a chain of dependent transactions across multiple grains to verify sequential transactional updates.

methods.name: TransactionTreeTest
methods.description: Tests concurrent transactions forming a tree structure, with some grains involved in multiple transactions, to verify proper transactional behavior.
